title: Spike: decode the current DAW's .asd (warp markers, mode, detune, loop) and test a hand-patched one
description:
## Intent
Answer M0 questions 1, 2 and 4 for the `.asd`: find where the current DAW version stores warp markers, warp on/off, warp mode, detune, start/end/loop, and the version marker; and check whether a hand-written `.asd` is honoured.

## Steps
1. Hex-diff the owner's reference files: same audio with different markers, modes and detune isolates each field.
2. Compare with the publicly documented older layouts (versions read by existing open-source parsers); note what moved.
3. Throwaway decoder in the scratchpad prints the markers of every reference `.asd`; they must equal the README table.
4. Hand-patch one `.asd` (move one marker), put it beside a fresh copy of the WAV, drag the WAV into the DAW: is the patched marker used? Repeat after changing the WAV's modification time, and with a copied WAV of a different length.
5. Record what triggers the DAW to rewrite the file.

## Output
A findings comment here and the `.asd` section of `design/daw-sidecars.md` §Formats (field, offset/encoding, versions, confidence).

## Verify (manual)
The scratch decoder's printout matches the fixture README for every reference `.asd`; the drag-in test result is recorded with the DAW version.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
## Findings (provisional: public files, no local DAW)

**Evidence set.** 4 MIT .asd from DBraun/AbletonParsing@26e8d4b (same audio, loop on/off, one pair from the 10.x generation, one pair labelled 12.x by its author); 365 more .asd surveyed in the scratchpad from public repos without a permissive licence (incl. producer-pal@4fa6b84 beside 12.3.x/12.4.x sets, and a 2026 repo that re-hosts library loops). Throwaway decoder: scratchpad sidecars/work/asd.py.

**Layout (little-endian).** 0: `06 49` magic ('I' = LE; `06 4D` big-endian exists for PowerPC-era files); 2: u32 N; 6: u32 0; 10: u32[N-1] frame grid, last entry = exact frame count of the audio (181675, checked against the WAV). Then document(s): magic `AB 1E 56 78`, u8 version 5, u32 365, ascii-str root class `SampleData`, i32 class-def count (21 in the 10.x file, 19 in the 12.x file = 18 classes + WarpMarker), a self-describing type dictionary (UTF-16 field names, type tags 0x10 bool, 0x11 i32, 0x12 f32, 0x17 f64), then values in schema order.

**SampleData value block (fixed 120 bytes).** 6 f64 LoopStart, LoopEnd, SampleOffset, HiddenLoopStart, HiddenLoopEnd, OutMarker (beats); 4 u8 Sync, HiQ, Fade, IsWarped; 4 f32 SampleVolume, VelocityAmount, PitchCoarse, PitchFine; u32 WarpMode; u32 TransientResolution; 3 f32 granularity; u32 TransientLoopMode; 3 f32; TimeSignature f32 num, f32 den, f64 time. Then [10.x only: Name as u32 len + UTF-16], i32 ColorIndex, u32 next marker id (NOT the count: 7 with ids 0 and 2), then per marker `00 0A 'WarpMarker'` u32 Id, f64 SecTime, f64 BeatTime, list end `00 00`, u8 MarkersGenerated, u32 LaunchMode, u8 LoopOn, u32 LaunchQuantisation, OnSets, AufTaktData, u32 OriginalFileSize, overview.

**Verified by diff.** loop on vs off differs only in LoopStart/LoopEnd/SampleOffset and LoopOn (v12 file offsets 3596..3619 and 3795). Decoder output equals AbletonParsing's own test expectations (start 0, end 5, hidden loop 4..6, loop 4..6 when on) for both generations; OriginalFileSize = 726746 = WAV byte size.

**No global version field** beyond the per-document byte 5; the generations differ by schema (Name dropped, BeatTrackState/PitchMarks dropped, AufTaktData added).

**Rewrite triggers.** Written on first analysis (no markers: 329 of 365 files carry an empty marker list); clip data only after the clip view's Save (vendor manual: "The clip data becomes part of the analysis file"), and for recorded/frozen audio. Stale check: OriginalFileSize (acidcat measured 96% match on 1,200 files). A third-party tool (elixirbeats/abletoolz@9b23618, GPL) reports the DAW ignores externally written .asd files and regenerates them.

Hand-patch drag-in test (step 4) and the owner's reference files still wait on the licensed install.
